ZZ9000 SDK headers (BlitterStudio's zz9000-firmware, sdk/), for Ambiance's
ZZ9000 video player (src/zz9k.c) only. Not kept in this repository: the
Makefile fetches them, unchanged, at the commit it pins (ZZ9K_SDK_COMMIT),
into build/zz9k-sdk:

  sdk/amiga/include   zz9k.library's and mpega.library's proto, clib,
                      inline, pragmas
  sdk/include         zz9k/abi.h and the SDK's types
  sdk/host/include    zz9k/request.h, reply.h: the media session's request
                      builders and reply decoders
  sdk/LICENSES/MIT.txt, LICENSING.md

https://github.com/BlitterStudio/zz9000-firmware

LICENCE: these headers are MIT (each file's SPDX line), except
sdk/include/zz9k/module.h and service_registry.h (GPL; fetched with the
folder, not included by Ambiance). zz9k.library and mpega.library
themselves are GPL-3.0-or-later, with an additional permission under GPL-3
section 7 that lets any program, whatever its licence, open them with
OpenLibrary() and call their public functions through the MIT headers
(LICENSING.md). Ambiance compiles in only those headers and opens
zz9k.library at run time; no library source or object code (zz9k_host.o
included) is built in.
